description: Stellar Care is a multidisciplinary team of young innovators participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We created CAREKI, a project combining artificial intelligence, physiological monitoring, and cognitive stimulation to support astronauts' physical and mental well-being. Our mission is to develop innovative solutions that protect those who make space exploration possible, proving that exploring new worlds also means learning to better care for humanity.
summary:
Stellar Care | NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

We are a multidisciplinary team of young innovators brought together by curiosity, creativity, and the desire to turn ideas into solutions with a global impact. We believe that great challenges require different perspectives, creative minds, and, above all, people willing to push the boundaries of what is possible.

Our participation in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 is driven by one belief: the future of space exploration depends not only on how far technology advances, but also on our ability to protect those who make every discovery possible.

This vision inspired CAREKI, our innovative technology project that combines artificial intelligence, physiological monitoring, and cognitive stimulation to support astronauts' physical and mental well-being. Our goal is to develop a tool that not only helps us better understand the challenges of living in space but also provides support to those who face them.

Beyond the competition, we want to learn, collaborate, and demonstrate that younger generations have the potential to contribute meaningful solutions to humanity's greatest challenges.

Because we believe that exploring new worlds also means learning how to better care for people.

And that is our mission: not only to prepare humans to reach space, but also to help prepare space to care for humans.
